nl_assertions.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user that there are 10 t-shirt options available.
nl_assertions.justification: The agent stated there are 11 available t-shirt variants, not 10. The expected outcome specifies 10, so the agent did not satisfy this expectation.

root_cause: Returned product has 12 variants, 10 available; agent said 11 available. No task/tool/scorer modification or score override.
